scope: Current C14 seated contact and exact printed-pocket preservation; exact-hash pump contact review. This is not a replacement for the complete assembly scorecard.

contact_classifier_review.bound: Only four exact unloaded rubber-foot envelopes below the independently derived cap plane are intentional contact. Rigid intersections, material outside those masks, missing named feet, a mismatched bearing plane or failed geometry query are not waived. Existing 1 mm3 gate tolerance remains explicit.

limits: C14 check is the seated state; no new complete rigid insertion sweep.
Pump findings bind the recorded materialized part and retained pose hashes; fresh shell regeneration can replace those shell hashes.
Whole-machine scorecard and actual complete-enclosure assembly remain separate.
